_comment: D-71 ratchet baseline (2 Oct 2026). The headline terminal is excess-return convergence over
the declared decay horizon. The pairs below have NO declared decay horizon and so fall back
to Gordon -- a gap the five-forces work owes (analyses/dnl/five_forces_driver_gap_audit_2026-09-25.md),
not a choice. The list may only SHRINK: a pair that gains a decay horizon must be removed,
and a new fallback fails tests/dcf/test_terminal_form.py.
Only the industrial FCFF engine (DNL) carries the form today. WBC and CSL are not listed
because their engines do not yet route through it -- that is the next pass, not a fallback.

reasons.dnl:fragmentation: The scenario write-up never assessed terminal ROIC or a moat length; it now sits 95bp above its WACC on the whole capital base under the ten-year horizon, so Gordon is the MORE generous reading and is baselined in tests/terminal_defence_baseline.json as well.
reasons.dnl:stagflation_persists: The scenario write-up never assessed terminal ROIC or a moat length; it sits 3.8pp below its WACC, so Gordon on the earned return is the LESS generous reading (convergence up would lift it, as it lifts Disorderly Climate).
